title: Book Two · Chapter 17: The Third Sign
story:
On Wednesday, Ronan takes the paper strip from his green book. He goes back to the first goat page.

The farmer makes a sign. The goat eats it. The farmer makes another. The goat eats that one, too.

Ronan reads those lines aloud. He says each sentence clearly. Then he looks at the third picture.

The farmer makes a third sign.

Ronan reads the next line. This time the farmer puts the sign higher on the wall. The goat can look up at it. Its mouth cannot reach the paper.

Ronan smiles. He closes the book and tries to tell the story.

“The goat eats a sign,” he says. “The farmer makes a new one.”

He stops. He missed the middle part of the story. He opens the book and counts the pictures.

“One. Two. Three.”

He takes three paper scraps from his drawing board. He puts them in a row. He moves the first two away. Then he holds the third above the goat in the picture.

“All right,” he says. “Again.”

At school, Miss Wu gives the class a short reading time. Each child can show one page to the table group.

Jun reads his funny fishing page. He does not reach the second shoe. Ronan still wants to see that part.

Then Ronan opens the goat book.

“Can I show all three pictures?” he asks.

Miss Wu looks at the pages. “Yes. We have time for that.”

Ronan reads the short lines. Then he turns the book toward Jun and Leo. He puts a finger on each sign in order.

“The first sign goes here. The goat eats it. The next sign goes here, too. The goat eats that one. The last sign is high.”

Jun puts his chin up and opens his mouth toward the book.

“I can't reach.”

“You are the goat,” Leo says.

Jun puts his chin down. “Only for this story.”

Ronan laughs. He shows the last picture again. Everyone at the table can see the high sign and the empty space below it.

Miss Wu moves to the next table. Ronan puts his book away. At break, Jun asks about the three paper scraps. Ronan shows them to him.

“Do you use these for every story?”

“No. Just for my three signs.”

Jun makes one scrap stand on its edge. It falls over. They try again beside the pencil box. This time it stays up.

After school, Ronan reaches the green gate. Mr Qiu is sorting some old books behind his table. One has a blue cover and a brown dog on the front.

“Is that for sale?” Ronan asks.

“Not that one. It is an old book of mine.”

Mr Qiu opens it to a picture of two dogs. One is wet. One stands well away from a water bowl.

Ronan bends to look.

“You can borrow it,” Mr Qiu says. “Bring it back on Saturday. Keep your hands dry.”

Mum comes to the gate and checks the cover. She agrees to the loan. Ronan carries the animal book inside. He puts it on his bed, away from the green school book.

In the kitchen, Mum opens the tap. The black cat looks toward the sound, then moves to the dry step.

Ronan points from the cat to the blue cover. Mum looks at both and laughs.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

farmer＝农夫；higher＝更高；three＝三；borrow＝借。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样练习讲清山羊故事？
2. Mr Qiu借给他的书要何时归还？

## 读句子

**The farmer / makes / a third sign.** 农夫／做出／第三块告示牌。
